candidate_workaround: Use the verified Windows system-local New Zealand offset alongside UTC and record the Windows timezone name separately.
failure_signature: Python raises a zone-info lookup error because the optional IANA tzdata package is absent on Windows.
recurrence_guard: Do not assume Windows Python ships an IANA zone database; use a verified system-local offset or an already approved runtime.
rollback: Retain the failed pre-generation builder invocation and install no package or runtime.
scope_boundary: Timestamp serialization recovery only; no external, scientific, or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Use verified Windows local time when optional IANA tzdata is absent
trigger_preconditions: A Windows Python runtime lacks the optional IANA timezone database and the host timezone has been verified.
